items.title: TheHiddenMemberJKT48
items.summary:
A seemingly normal portrait contains an elusive presence. Can you reconstruct the damaged boundaries and uncover the secrets within?
TL;DR TheHiddenMemberJKT48 is an advanced steganography challenge that combines file-carver evasion with color distribution analysis. The provided image ( Last_seen.jpg ) contains two concatenated JPEG streams. The second image was deliberately modified by stripping the standard Start-of-Image ( FF D8 ) and APP0 ( FF E0 ) headers while corrupting the JFIF identifier to JFIP , defeating automated tools like binwalk and foremost . Manually reconstructing the missing headers and analyzing the extracted image with AperiSolve’s color remapping filter reveals the hidden flag. 1.
